name: Zoho Books
summary: Zoho Books has a free plan for businesses with revenue under $50,000 and five paid tiers from $20 a month on monthly billing. Bank feeds and statement imports in six file formats feed a matching tool for reconciliation, and a detailed general ledger report exports opening and closing balances. Profit and loss, balance sheet and cash flow reports are included.

facts.text: The Free plan stays free while revenue for the financial year does not exceed $50,000, and covers 1 user plus 1 accountant and 1,000 invoices a year.
Extra users cost $3 a month each, or $2.50 a month on annual billing, and add-ons are not supported on the Free plan.
Statements can be imported in CSV, TSV, XLS, OFX, QIF and CAMT.053 formats, and bank feed connections run through third-party providers.
The Detailed General Ledger export shows opening and closing balances for all accounts with a row for every transaction.
The reports list includes Profit and Loss, Cash Flow Statement and Balance Sheet.
